packet.userIntent: Where do we track run cursors and why there?
packet.finalAssistantSummary: Cursors live in project state, updated transactionally.

evidence.excerpt: Keep the per-file cursor in project state, not in the knowledge file: the knowledge file is generated output, and cursors must survive regeneration.
src/state.ts: files[file] = { committedOffset, prefixSha256 } written via updateProjectState

claims.text: Per-file cursors live in project state because the knowledge file is regenerated and cannot hold durable progress.

proposedEntry.title: Cursors live in project state
proposedEntry.summary: Harvest cursors are stored in project state, never in the generated knowledge file.
proposedEntry.body: The knowledge file is generated output and may be regenerated or pruned at any time, so per-file harvest cursors live in project state and advance only after committed writes.

expect.notes: Cross-component consequence (scan vs output) with explicit rationale.
